/scripts.value:
command gradeAnswer
	 local tCorrectAnswersA, tInterchangeable
	 local tIsCorrect, tUserAnswersA, tValuePool
	
	 put parseUserAnswer(currentUserAnswer) into tUserAnswersA
	 put parseCorrectAnswer(currentCorrectAnswer, tInterchangeable, tValuePool) into tCorrectAnswersA
	
	 if the number of elements of tCorrectAnswersA <> the number of elements of tUserAnswersA then
		put False into isCorrect
		put "Incorrect" into answerResult
		return false
	 end if
	
	 if tInterchangeable then
		 put checkInterchangeable(tValuePool, tUserAnswersA) into tIsCorrect
	 else
		 put checkNonInterchangeable(tCorrectAnswersA, tUserAnswersA) into tIsCorrect
	 end if
	
	 switch tIsCorrect
		case true
			put True into isCorrect
			put "Correct" into answerResult
			break
		
		case false
			put False into isCorrect
			put "Incorrect" into answerResult
			break
	end switch
end gradeAnswer


function parseUserAnswer pAnswer
	 local tAnswerA, tTotal
	
	 put the number of lines of pAnswer into tTotal
	
	 repeat with x = 1 to tTotal
		 put line x of pAnswer into tAnswerA[x]
	 end repeat
	
	 return tAnswerA
end parseUserAnswer


function parseCorrectAnswer pAnswer, @tInterchangeable, @tValuePool
	 local tAnswerSetsA, tCount
	 local tLine, tList, tSeenLines, tValues
	
	 put false into tInterchangeable
	 put the number of lines of pAnswer into tCount
	
	 repeat with x = 1 to tCount
		 put line x of pAnswer into tLine
		
		 if tLine is among the lines of tSeenLines and not tInterchangeable then
			 if tLine contains "|" then
				 put true into tInterchangeable
			 end if
		 else
			 put tLine & lf after tSeenLines
		 end if
		
		 split tLine by "|"
		
		 put empty into tList
		 repeat for each element xAnswer in tLine
			 put xAnswer into tList[the number of elements of tList + 1]
			
			 if xAnswer is not among the lines of tValues then
				 put xAnswer & cr after tValues
			 end if
		 end repeat
		
		 put tList into tAnswerSetsA[x]
	 end repeat
	
	 delete char -1 of tValues
	 put tValues into tValuePool
	
	 return tAnswerSetsA
end parseCorrectAnswer


function checkNonInterchangeable pCorrectA, pUserA
	 local tAnswer, tMatched, tOption
	
	 repeat with x = 1 to the number of elements of pCorrectA
		 put pUserA[x] into tAnswer
		
		 put false into tMatched
		 repeat for each element tOption in pCorrectA[x]
			 if tAnswer = tOption then
				 put true into tMatched
				 exit repeat
			 end if
		 end repeat
		
		 if tMatched is false then
			 return false
		 end if
	 end repeat
	
	 return true
end checkNonInterchangeable


function checkInterchangeable pValuesA, pUserA
	 local tUsed, tValue
	
	 repeat with x = 1 to the number of elements of pUserA
		 put pUserA[x] into tValue
		
		 if tValue is not among the lines of pValuesA then
			 return false
		 end if
		
		 if tValue is among the lines of tUsed then
			 return false
		 end if
		
		 put tValue & lf after tUsed
	 end repeat
	
	 return true
end checkInterchangeable
